title: Sampler
description: Texture sampler properties for filtering and wrapping modes.

magFilter.title: Magnification Filter
magFilter.description: Filter used when the texture's rendered dimensions are greater than its original dimensions.

anyOf.title: Nearest
anyOf.description: Nearest-neighbor filtering, also known as point filtering.

minFilter.title: Minification Filter
minFilter.description: Filter used when the texture's rendered dimensions are less than its original dimensions.

anyOf.title: Nearest
anyOf.description: Nearest-neighbor filtering, also known as point filtering, without mipmapping.

anyOf.title: Nearest Mipmap Nearest
anyOf.description: Nearest-neighbor filtering from the closest mipmap.

anyOf.title: Linear Mipmap Nearest
anyOf.description: Linear filtering from the closest mipmap.

anyOf.title: Nearest Mipmap Linear
anyOf.description: Nearest-neighbor filtering from the two closest mipmaps followed by linear filtering between them.

anyOf.title: Linear Mipmap Linear
anyOf.description: Linear filtering from the two closest mipmaps followed by linear filtering between them, also known as trilinear filtering.

wrapS.title: S (U) Wrapping
wrapS.description: Wrapping mode for horizontal texture coordinates less than zero or greater than or equal to one.

anyOf.title: Repeat
anyOf.description: The normalized range is repeated infinitely.

anyOf.title: Clamp to Edge
anyOf.description: The out-of-bounds texture coordinates are clamped.

anyOf.title: Mirrored Repeat
anyOf.description: The normalized range is repeated infinitely, reversing the direction on every repeat.

wrapT.title: T (V) Wrapping
wrapT.description: Wrapping mode for vertical texture coordinates less than zero or greater than or equal to one.

anyOf.title: Repeat
anyOf.description: The normalized range is repeated infinitely.

anyOf.title: Clamp to Edge
anyOf.description: The out-of-bounds texture coordinates are clamped.

anyOf.title: Mirrored Repeat
anyOf.description: The normalized range is repeated infinitely, reversing the direction on every repeat.
